## Configuration

the file that declares them. These are configuration rather than API: a key that disappears
from here is a key a deployed config stops receiving.

## What this page is not

The record is read syntactically from the files the package ships, so this is a list of names
rather than a behaviour guide. A method declared by a parent class or a trait is listed under
the class that declares it, not under every class that inherits or uses it; a member marked
`@internal` still counts; and properties and constants a consumer can see but the reader could
not name are absent. What it is for is the question a release asks — did a name a host
application depends on move — and for that, a syntactic reading is the correct one, because it
is what a consumer's compiler sees.
